name: network-diagnostics
description: Safely measure and diagnose macOS home-network bottlenecks with repeatable JSON results.

interface.shortDescription: Measure and diagnose slow home Internet safely.
interface.longDescription: Run privacy-conscious macOS measurements for Wi-Fi, IPv6, latency, route hops, DNS, throughput, and responsiveness; compare labeled JSON results and separate evidence from unverified causes.
defaultPrompt: Measure my slow home Internet connection and identify the bottleneck from evidence.
Compare my before and after network measurements and rank effective fixes.
Check whether missing IPv6 or low RPM explains my poor network experience.
